description: Resolve up to 100 inputs in one call to canonical tracks plus cross-platform links. input_type picks the key: 'track_name' (items are {artist, title} objects), 'isrc', 'sonovault_id', or a platform id type ('spotify_id', 'applemusic_id', 'tidal_id', 'beatport_id', 'discogs_id', 'musicbrainz_id'). A discogs_id item is a Discogs track key (release ID plus track position, e.g. '2844-A'), not a bare release ID. Costs one API credit per line.

items.description: Strings for id/isrc types; {artist, title} objects for track_name

name: resolve_tracks
title: Bulk resolve
